We also encourage you to pursue your own innovative work that brings fresh perspectives to the field. You'll work closely with your advisors and committee members to choose courses and research directions. You'll also complete an MA thesis to demonstrate your competency in critically examining an anthropologically interesting problem. Graduates may move on to a PhD program, to a teaching career at the secondary or junior college level, or to other specialized employment, such as cultural resource management in archaeology or applied work in cultural anthropology in the public interest. Most students should complete the MA program within two years of full-time study.
